subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

She said to me, "We are going to live in a new city from next month onwards until my brother gets a new job."

options.text: She told me that they will be going to live in a new city from the next month onwards until her brother gets a new job.
She told me that they were going to live in a new city from the following month onwards until her brother got a new job.
She told me that she was going to live in a new city from the following month onwards until her brother gets a new job.
She told me that they were going to live in a new city from the following month onwards until my brother got a new job.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rule for Indirect Speech Conversion:** When converting direct speech to indirect speech, the following changes are applied:
 
 
• Present tense verbs in the original sentence are changed to past tense in indirect speech.
 
• Words indicating time and place are modified. For example, "next month" becomes "the following month."
 
• Pronouns are adjusted according to the speaker and listener.
